name: dsh-sidebar-suite
author: Yonan
description: 一款专门针对改进 DSH 左侧栏体验的插件：三种布局一键切换、默认布局在详情页顶部直接设、会话列表默认全展开、「临时会话」开原生会话且默认在退出 DSH 时删除（DELETE_ON_EXIT 默认开；每天定时清理默认关，可在详情页开启并自设时间）、详情页三种反馈入口 —— 强实用性；界面沿用宿主原生配色、圆角与间距，只加属性与一条控制栏、不重构宿主结构 —— 克制美观。｜A plugin dedicated to the DSH sidebar experience: one-click layouts, always-expanded sessions, native temp sessions deleted when DSH quits by default (DELETE_ON_EXIT on; daily cleanup off by default and opt-in) and in-page settings/feedback — seriously practical; native colours, radii and spacing with zero host-DOM rewrites — restrained and good-looking.

scripts.test: node tests/test_020.mjs && node tests/test_022.mjs && node tests/test_023.mjs && node tests/test_024.mjs && node tests/test_025.mjs
scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/temp-session-host.mjs && npm pack --dry-run
